connector_limitation: The GitHub connector rejects binary blob content as non-UTF-8. Preserve the gzip binary and a byte-identical base64 text alias. The alias was fetched in full, decoded and SHA-256 verified; the gzip Git blob SHA-1 was also independently recomputed from exact Git blob framing.
decode: base64 decode full-logs-r1.json.gz.base64, then gzip decompress and read files.workspace.stdout.text and files.workspace.stderr.text; UTF-8 encoding of each text field reproduces its exact terminal SHA-256.
